hooks.command: hook_root="${LU_PRODUCT_ROOT:-}" && if [ -z "$hook_root" ]; then hook_common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" && hook_root="$(cd "$hook_common/.." && pwd -P)"; fi && export LU_PRODUCT_ROOT="$hook_root" && LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$hook_root/.venv/bin/python}" bash "$hook_root/scripts/pre_commit/project_python.sh" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agent_runtime/codex_hook_entry.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' pre-tool-use || { printf "Codex hook bootstrap failed; blocking the tool call\n" >&2; exit 2; }

"${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agent_runtime/codex_hook_entry.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' post-tool-use

"${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python}" -I -c 'import os, sys; from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path; os.environ["LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON"] = sys.executable; os.execv("/bin/bash", ["bash", str(machinery_path("agent_runtime/codex_hook_entry.sh")), *sys.argv[1:]])' user-prompt-submit
